channel.title: Million Dollar Mountain Homes
channel.desc: Thirteen rentals later, Keith and Andrea have finally decided on buying over building their dream home. With sights set on the serenity of Lake Burton, they tour everything from traditional luxe to turnkey convenience, and even a reno-ready steal. With three options only a bunkroom apart, which one will best suit this ultramodern family of fourteen?
